decisions.executionNote: Keep both arms stationary and observe the demonstrator's object sequence.
Remain still. Demonstrator is approaching the phone first; watch for pickup.
Observe without moving: first demonstrated pickup is the phone.
Remain stationary as the phone is lowered into the demonstration basket; sequence begins phone.
Phone is in the demo basket. Continue observing the next selection without moving.
Continue stationary observation; demonstrator approaches the black camera after the phone.
Observe second pickup, the black camera, while keeping arm poses fixed.
Hold stationary. Remember sequence so far: phone, black camera; observe second placement.
Continue observing without arm motion. Phone then black camera have been carried to the demo basket.
Remain stationary, remembering phone then camera; observe the third object selection.
Hold both arms still. Demonstrator is selecting green watch third, after phone and camera.
Stationary observation. Third pickup is green watch; remembered order is phone, camera, watch.
Remain still as the demonstrator places the third object, green watch. Order: phone, camera, watch.
Watch has been released in demo basket. Hold still and observe fourth selection; remember phone, camera, watch.
Continue stationary observation for fourth object after phone, camera, watch.
Hold still. Demonstrator approaches wooden car fourth; remembered first three are phone, camera, watch.
Observe fourth pickup, wooden car. Keep arms still; sequence phone, camera, watch, car.
Keep stationary as wooden car is placed fourth. Remember phone, camera, watch, car; doll remains.
Remain stationary until the demonstration finishes. Four placed objects: phone, camera, watch, wooden car.
Hold still, observing final doll selection. Remember phone, camera, watch, wooden car, then doll.
Remain still while demonstrator picks the doll fifth. Sequence: phone, camera, watch, wooden car, doll.
Keep stationary until fifth placement and demonstrator return. Memorized order: phone, camera, watch, wooden car, doll.
Wait for the doll's final placement and demonstrator return. Order retained: phone, camera, watch, car, doll.
Remain stationary while the demonstrator carries the fifth object, doll, to its basket.
Wait for fifth release and demonstrator return; sequence phone, camera, watch, wooden car, doll.
All five demonstrated objects appear in basket. Wait for opposite arm to finish returning before moving; order phone, camera, watch, car, doll.
Continue waiting for opposite arm to settle at origin; all five objects remain in demonstration basket.
Allow opposite arm to finish settling at origin before imitation. Retain order: phone, camera, watch, car, doll.
Demonstration finished at origin. Begin phone first: raise and pitch right wrist toward a top-down approach, keeping left arm parked.
Advance right wrist above the phone while completing downward pitch. Maintain clearance and elbow-up continuity.
Align right gripper across the phone's narrow dimension while lowering cautiously above it.
Lower open right gripper to phone grasp height with a small forward centering correction.
Descend the final short distance and close the right gripper around the phone; retention will be checked on lift.
Lift phone gently with right gripper commanded closed, checking visual retention before central staging.
Phone appears retained. Carry it toward a clear central staging area without crossing the arms, maintaining closed grip and clearance.
Lower retained phone onto clear central tabletop for a sequential left-arm pickup; keep right wrist on its own side.
Release phone on central tabletop, withdraw right arm upward and rightward, and prepare left arm's downward grasp orientation without crossing.
Approach staged phone from left while right arm withdraws fully to its own workspace. Keep left gripper open and above tabletop.
Align left gripper vertically over the staged phone's left-center, lowering cautiously. Right arm stays clear.
Lower left fingers around the staged phone and close; right arm remains clear of the handoff.
Lift the phone in the left gripper, maintaining closed command and checking retention before moving toward the policy basket.
Phone is visibly retained. Carry it leftward above the policy basket with clearance, keeping the right arm parked.
Center retained phone inside the policy basket footprint and lower it to a safe release height.
Release phone first into policy basket and lift left hand clear. Approach second object, black camera, with right arm.
Phone rests in basket. Align and descend the right gripper over the black camera, second in the sequence.
Make a small centering correction, lower around the camera body, and close the right gripper.
Lift the second object, camera, then carry it toward the central staging area with closed right grip.
Stage retained camera near center, lowering above tabletop; orient the distant left gripper for its narrow dimension.
Set camera down centrally, open right gripper, and withdraw rightward while left approaches from its own side at clearance height.
Camera settled slightly forward of staging point. Align left approach over it with mild wrist tilt, keeping left EE on its side and right arm clear.
Lower open left gripper toward the settled camera, adjusting tilt to align fingertips without moving the arm across the centerline.
Finish the left camera grasp, close firmly by position target, and make a short test lift to verify retention.
Camera appears retained. Raise above the basket rim and begin carrying left, keeping both arm configurations continuous.
Carry retained camera above the empty far half of the policy basket, clear of the first phone.
Lower camera into the basket, release it second after the phone, and lift the left fingers clear.
Camera is in basket. Approach the green watch third with the left arm, straightening the grasp approach above it.
Descend open left gripper over the watch loop, with a small centering correction; retain order phone, camera, watch, car, doll.
Lower the last short distance around the watch, close left gripper, and test retention with a gentle lift.
Watch retention is uncertain: reopen, move slightly forward and lower to engage the loop, then close and test lift.
Watch is now between the fingers. Lift with closed grip and begin moving toward the basket, checking retention.
Watch remains retained. Move over the free near portion of the policy basket, avoiding the phone and camera.
Release watch third into the basket and lift clear. Position right arm above wooden car for the fourth step.
Watch rests in basket third. Lower the right gripper above the wooden car, aligning around its narrow body.
Lower the final distance, close around the wooden car, and test with a short vertical lift.
Car appears retained. Raise it and carry to central staging for the left arm, keeping right EE on its side.
Set the car down centrally and release. Bring left arm partway toward staging while maintaining separation.
Withdraw right hand from the staged car and align left fingers above it, maintaining separation and a slight inward fingertip tilt.
Align left fingers over the car's shifted resting position and descend cautiously with a small inward tilt, keeping the wrist left of center.
Finish aligning around the wooden car, close the left gripper and make a short test lift before basket transport.
Lift the retained wooden car above rim height, then carry left toward the basket for the fourth placement.
Move the retained fourth object over the basket center, keeping it above the previously placed objects.
Release wooden car fourth in the policy basket, then lift clear before retrieving the final doll.
Four objects are in the basket. Approach the final doll from the left, keeping the wrist left of center and fingers tilted toward its torso.
Center left fingers around the final doll's torso and lower cautiously, keeping the right arm stationary and the left wrist on its own side.
Lower around the doll's torso, close left gripper, and test with a short lift before the fifth placement.
Doll was not retained. Reopen, shift forward toward its torso and lower further, then close and test-lift again.
Doll is visibly between the fingers. Lift clear and start leftward transport with closed grip for the fifth placement.
Carry the retained doll over the near-middle of the policy basket, keeping clearance above the four earlier objects.
Lower and release the doll fifth into the policy basket, then lift the open left gripper clear.
All five objects appear in the basket. Begin returning both open hands to origin, unwinding the right wrist gradually and clearing the basket with the left.
